No. 11 of 2025
AN ACT to amend the Administration of Small Successions
Act, Cap. 4.12.
[ 28th May, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

192
No. 11 ] Administration of Small Successions [ 2025
(Amendment) Act
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Administration of Small
Successions (Amendment) Act, 2025.
Amendment of section 2
2. Section 2 of the principal Act is amended by inserting in the
correct alphabetical sequence the following new definition —
“ “Minister” means the Minister responsible for justice;”.
Amendment of section 3
3. Section 3 of the Administration of Small Successions Act,
Cap. 4.12 is amended —
(a) in the section heading, by deleting the words “$5,000”
and by substituting the words “$50,000”;
(b) in subsection (1), by deleting the words “$5,000”
and by substituting the words “$50,000”;
(c) by inserting immediately after subsection (1), the following
new subsection (1A) —
“(1A) Notwithstanding subsection (1), the Minister may,
by Order published in the Gazette, amend the value under
subsection (1).”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 10th day of July, 2025.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 15th day of July, 2025.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
